intro: Down the Rabbit Hole AUST provides lawn mowing Inner North Canberra homeowners can set and forget, covering Lyneham, O'Connor, Dickson, Downer, Ainslie, Braddon, Acton, Watson, Hackett, Reid and Campbell. These are Canberra's oldest suburbs, with Reid, Ainslie and Braddon dating from the 1920s, and the garden-city planting has left the streets lined with mature deciduous trees.
We are fully insured, ABN registered and locally operated, with 60+ Canberra lawns maintained since 2021. Quotes are free and upfront, and green waste removal is available with every mow.

sections.h2: Why regular mowing suits heritage gardens and shared lawns
paras: An established lawn under mature trees grows slowly, but it is also easy to lose. Shade, leaf litter and tree roots thin the grass, and a fortnightly cut keeps what is there at a steady height while shading out bindi and broadleaf weeds.
Shared lawns at Braddon and Dickson complexes are small but on show every day. Regular lawn mowing Inner North wide covers both, from a cottage frontage in O'Connor to a courtyard strip in Lyneham.

sections.h2: Inner North seasons and leaf drop
paras: Autumn is the big one here. The street trees drop heavily, and lawns in Ainslie, Hackett and Watson, which back onto the Mount Ainslie and Mount Majura reserves, get bush litter too. We rake, mow and remove it with the clippings so the grass keeps breathing.

Hard frosts from May to August stop most lawns growing, so we drop to a monthly tidy. From September the spring surge arrives and our lawn mowing Inner North visits move to fortnightly. In summer we cut higher and less often so the lawn holds moisture, with water restrictions in mind.

sections.h2: How to book mowing in the Inner North
paras: Text 0423 720 317 or use the form below with your street and a note about the block. We quote upfront for free and set a schedule if you want one. For lawn mowing Inner North wide, most lawns are best cut every one to two weeks in the growing season and every two to four weeks in the cooler months, with an extra leaf clean-up in autumn.

faqs.q: Which Inner North suburbs do you cover?
faqs.a: All of them. Our lawn mowing Inner North service covers Lyneham, O'Connor, Dickson, Downer, Ainslie, Braddon, Acton, Watson, Hackett, Reid and Campbell. Nature strips can be included in the visit, and we edge along the kerb and footpath.

faqs.q: Do you clear autumn leaves as well as mow?
faqs.a: Yes. Leaf drop from the deciduous street trees is heavy across the district, and we rake, mow and remove it with the clippings on every lawn mowing Inner North visit. If the fall is heavy we can add an extra clean-up so the lawn is not smothered.

faqs.q: Can you mow a small shared lawn at a Braddon or Dickson complex?
faqs.a: Yes. Shared lawns at apartment and townhouse complexes are welcome, and strata managers and owners' committees are welcome to book as well as owners. Tell us who to invoice and where the access is, and we will set up a schedule.

faqs.q: Do you take the grass clippings and green waste away?
faqs.a: Yes. Green waste removal is available with every mowing visit, and with garden maintenance and clean-ups too. If you would rather keep some clippings for compost or mulch, tell us and we will leave what you want.
